sets.title: 圖書館開放時間調整
sets.description: 從校園公告找出時間與原因。
sets.passage: The library will stay open an hour longer during exam week so that students have more time to study. Normal opening hours will {{q1}} on the following Monday.
sets.passageZh: 考試週期間，圖書館會延後一小時閉館，讓學生有更多時間讀書。隔週一將恢復平常的開放時間。

cloze.explanation: resume 表示恢復。公告說明延長開放只是暫時調整，隔週一將恢復平常的開放時間。

vocabulary.example: Regular bus services will resume once the bridge has reopened to traffic.
vocabulary.exampleZh: 橋梁恢復通車後，公車將恢復正常班次。
vocabulary.note: resume normal service，恢復正常服務
